quest.title: The Island
quest.description: Examining the Fetish closely, the Shaman found that, while it's purpose seemed complex, the actual design was fairly primitive. What was odd was that it did not seem to originate from any of the barbaric tribes he knew. There was, perhaps, one odd coincidence here. Quite closeby there was an island shared by three primitive types of creature that each could easily have devised such an item. He suggested, therefore, that your search began there and marked the location upon your map.

node.journal_entry: The Nalaed, you discovered, practiced a primitive sort of nature magic and tapped into the binding energies of the nearby spiders' websacks.

The Hobgobs, your 'informant' revealed before shuffling off his mortal coils, practiced a fairly necromantic form of primitive magic. Their prime catalyst in their rituals was ectoplasm gathered from wisps that haunted the nearby shoreline.
Under your gentle questioning, the Matayin revealed a vile practice indeed. The Matayin spellcrafters actually sacrificed their own progeny, in the form of their eggs, in their dark magics!
It took some work but you eventually managed to separate the Websacks from your fingers (after you separated them from the spiders) in order to stow them in your pack.
The ectoplasm had an infuriating habit of sliding right through your hands whilst somehow succeeding in staining you with it's gooey goodness. Eventually, however, you managed to gather enough.
With the five eggs squelching together rather delightfully, you bound the pouch strings tightly and did your best to ignore the stench!

With all three prime ritualistic ingredients from the nearby denizens acquired, it was time to see which, if any, of these types of magic might have had a hand in the crafting of the Fetish. The Shaman had provided you with a retro-ritualistic rite that should suffice. All you needed was a handy altar!

node.instruction: Locate and interact with a nearby altar.

action.tag: An Add Quest Area to World-Map Action

node.journal_entry: You placed the three sets of ingredients upon the altar and began the investigative spell. Slowly, imperceptibly at first but gathering in resonance, the altar began to hum with dark power. From what the Shaman had said, if one the ingredients was involved in the ritual in question, it would glow and you would receive a smoky vision of the perpetrators.

action.tag: A Start Client SFX on Player Action

node.instruction: Follow the marker on your map
node.journal_entry: You arrived at the island indicated by the Shaman on your map. At first glance it did seem eerily quiet though the number of smoke fires drifting slowly through the sky above held a foreboding feeling of the quiet before the storm.

action.tag: An Add Map-Marker to World-Map Action

node.journal_entry: The Shaman had said that in order to determine if any of the primitive magics of the three monster communities inhabiting the island were involved in the creation of the Fetish, you would likely have to gather the materials they used most often and perform a reverse ritualistic spell.
Before doing that, however, you needed to discover what these materials might be. This, the Ork had said with a gleeful grin, would, of course, involve violence!

action.tag: An Add Quest Area to World-Map Action

node.journal_entry: With that in mind then, it must have come as a small shock when all three ingredients glowed brightly and the smoky apparition that rose out of the flames belonged to none of the three tribes present on the Island!

node.instruction: You need to have all the ingredients in your backpack before you interacting with the altar.
